title: EVALUATING LLM-GENERATED Q&A TEST: A STUDENT-CENTERED STUDY

bias_targets.methodology: Uniform Differential Item Functioning (DIF) analysis using logistic regression on estimated ability to detect if test items function systematically differently for examinees in 'high' versus 'low' ability subgroups.
Human expert screening of generated test items to mitigate culturally-loaded distractors and ensure the LLM's phrasing does not unfairly privilege certain students.
